description: Aggregate statistics (mean, min, max, std) over a polygon area: weather, terrain, hazards, environment, soil, and population. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] pairs forming a simple ring (no self-intersections). Maximum area depends on plan (free tier: 100 km2, measured on the sphere). Weather units follow the chosen mode, as in get_current_weather, get_weather_forecast and get_historical_climate. Use for area questions such as average slope of a farm or population inside a zone.

day.description: Forecast day for mode=forecast, 0-based (0 is the first forecast day, the day after the GFS run date). forecast_dates in the response lists all available days

mode.description: Weather source: nowcast for current conditions (GFS), forecast for a forecast day (set day), historical for 2015-2024 ERA5 averages (set month, or omit it for the annual climate)

month.description: Month 1-12 for mode=historical. Omit it for the annual climate

name: get_polygon_stats
title: Polygon statistics
